response.overview: BoJack Horseman, a former sitcom star struggling to regain his fame, navigates the ups and downs of life in Hollywood while dealing with addiction, relationships, and his own personal demons. Surrounded by friends, agents, and fellow celebrities, BoJack attempts to find meaning and happiness while confronting the consequences of his past.
response.tagline: Back in the ’90s, I was in a very famous TV show.
response.title: Bojack Horseman
